title: Prehistoric Hunt
description:
In Prehistoric Hunt your task is to hunt the rarest dinosaurs from a challenging primal environment. Will you be able to complete your hunting contracts or will you turn into the hunted?

DINOSAURSYou can hunt a wide variety of 27 dinosaur species including Tyrannosaurus Rex, Spinosaurus, Stegosaurus, Quetzalcoatlus, and Utahraptor. Each of them have their own behavior and characteristics. Our species live on land, water, and air! Beware, as the dinosaurs can hunt both you and each other. 

ENVIRONMENTExplore dense tropical jungles, open plains and high mountains. The weather changes dynamically. Experience a full day and night cycle. Discover new special locations. Move on foot, swim or fast travel. Game features 3 large islands to explore. Find story notes to learn about the history of the islands. 

TROPHY LODGEBuild a customizable trophy lodge with multiple rooms to store your full-sized dinosaur trophies. Choose what to include from a selection of mounts, furniture and rooms.

TROPHY SHOTSTake trophy shots with your catch and store memories from your hunting trips.

MULTIPLAYER OR SOLOPlay solo or multiplayer with up to 12 players.

WEAPONS AND HUNTING EQUIPMENTChoose from 15 different weapons including .700 double rifle, revolver, .50 cal heavy rifle and hunting bow. Utilize a vast variety of hunting utility from callers to range finder. Purchase new equipment from the shop or find new items in loot boxes. 

NOTE FROM DEVELOPERJoin our great community on Discord!

You can influence what features will be implemented into the game. We welcome any feedback and development ideas. Thank you for your support!
description_short: Dive into intense dinosaur hunting adventures with your friends. Complete hunting contracts for Preton Corporation. Gather rewards, improve your equipment and become a master hunter. Are you the hunter or the hunted?
